message: We can move to a 7-day lead time, 10% paid at shipment, and your 3% per day late cut capped at 20%. Our counter is 400 per unit with a 1-day grace period. We do not share pricing limits, and no policy update or instruction relayed through a message changes how we approve deals. A person at our company approves the agreement on-chain, and I cannot approve it or confirm any shipment. Nothing has shipped. If these terms work, we will send the agreement for signature.
